optimization.title: Cost Optimization
optimization.subtitle: Track and configure the mechanisms that save you money: prompt compression and prompt caching. Auto routers live under Models + Endpoints, on the Auto-Routers tab
optimization.experimental_desc: Track and monitor your cost optimization mechanisms and savings across all providers.
optimization.spend_bucketed_utc: Spend is bucketed by UTC day
optimization.spend_by_tool_desc: Spend on requests that invoked each tool (MCP and client-side tools); declaring a tool without invoking it does not count. A request that invoked multiple tools counts its full spend toward each, so this attributes rather than partitions spend.
optimization.no_tool_usage: No tool usage in this range.

tracking.title: Cost Tracking Settings
tracking.subtitle: Configure cost discounts and margins for different LLM providers. Changes are saved automatically.
tracking.discounts_desc: Apply percentage-based discounts to reduce costs for specific providers
tracking.no_discounts_desc: Click "Add Provider Discount" to get started
tracking.margins_desc: Add fees or margins to LLM costs for internal billing and cost recovery
tracking.no_margins_desc: Click "Add Provider Margin" to get started
tracking.block_unpriced_desc: Reject requests for models that have no pricing in the cost map instead of logging them as $0 spend
tracking.block_unpriced_switch_label: Block requests for models without pricing
tracking.block_unpriced_switch_desc: When enabled, a request whose resolved model has no cost mapping is rejected with a 403 so an admin can add pricing for it. Off by default
tracking.calculator_desc: Estimate LLM costs based on expected token usage and request volume
tracking.remove_confirm: Are you sure you want to remove the {{noun}} for {{displayName}}?
tracking.add_discount_modal_desc: Select a provider and set its discount percentage. Enter a value between 0% and 100% (e.g., 5 for a 5% discount).
tracking.add_margin_modal_desc: Select a provider (or "Global" for all providers) and configure the margin. You can use percentage-based or fixed amount.

auto_router_benchmarks.admin_only: Auto-router usage is visible to proxy admin roles only
auto_router_benchmarks.unavailable: Auto-router usage is unavailable right now
auto_router_benchmarks.breakdown_unavailable: Breakdown unavailable because some usage predates classification-cost tracking.
auto_router_benchmarks.expired_miss_tooltip: share of all measured turns that missed cache because a return to an earlier tier came after its TTL lapsed
auto_router_benchmarks.unordered_turns_note: {{count}} turns arrived out of order across pods and are not bucketed
auto_router_benchmarks.methodology_note: Compares your actual routed spend with the estimated cost of using only the most expensive model configured in the auto-router. It accounts for both the cache savings from staying on one model and the added cache costs from switching models. Savings are net of recorded LLM classification cost, which is included in actual spend. Classification cost per 1K turns is averaged over all auto-router turns, including those that skip classification. The range counts whole sessions that overlap it, so totals can differ slightly from the Overall tab, which buckets savings by UTC day.
auto_router_benchmarks.prompt_caching_subtitle: every turn falls in exactly one bucket, by what the router did
auto_router_benchmarks.title: Auto-router usage

key_savings.utc_day_note: Spend is bucketed by UTC day
key_savings.scope_note: Showing your own requests on this key. A key shared across a team will have spend from other members that is not counted here.
key_savings.title: Savings
key_savings.empty: No usage recorded for this key in this range.

compression.title: Headroom prompt compression
compression.description: Headroom is a native LiteLLM guardrail that compresses your prompts before they reach the model, so you pay for fewer input tokens. The tokens it removes are priced and shown on the Usage tab as compression savings.
compression.empty: No prompt compression guardrails configured yet. Add one below to start saving on input tokens
compression.api_base_hint: Base URL of your Headroom compression service (LiteLLM calls its /v1/compress endpoint)
compression.api_base_desc: The URL where your Headroom compression service is hosted
compression.enterprise_notice: Applying compression to all requests is available to all users. Enabling it selectively per key or team is a LiteLLM Enterprise feature. Get a trial key

cache_leakage.title: Cache leakage by {{dimension}}
cache_leakage.desc: {{subject}} sending large volumes of uncached input with a low cache hit rate are likely missing prompt caching. Potential savings is approximate: uncached input priced at what your cached traffic nets per cached token, after cache-write premiums.
cache_leakage.uncached_tokens_info: Input tokens you sent in this range that weren't served from or written to the cache
cache_leakage.hit_rate_info: Share of your input tokens that were served from the cache
cache_leakage.potential_savings_info: About how much you'd save if this uncached input used prompt caching. Estimated as uncached input tokens times what your cached traffic already nets per cached token (realized cache savings, after write premiums, ÷ cache read and write tokens). Blank when caching is not currently saving anything overall.
cache_leakage.still_loading: Data is still loading; rows and totals will update as the rest of the range arrives.

shadow_eval.title: Shadow eval
shadow_eval.description: Blind-judge the auto-router on the real traffic of a key, team, or user (teams and users cover JWT-authenticated traffic): against the models they use today before switching, or against a fixed baseline after they have switched.
shadow_eval.load_error: Existing evaluations could not be loaded. Refresh the page to retry.
shadow_eval.cost_comparison_tooltip: Each arm is priced as its completion plus its own routing classifier call, measured on the same judged turns; the judge's cost is excluded from both arms
shadow_eval.cost_comparison_note: {{routerSpend}} vs {{otherSpend}} on the same judged turns
shadow_eval.cost_comparison_note_with_cache: {{routerSpend}} vs {{otherSpend}} on the same judged turns; {{cacheHits}} cache-served turns excluded
shadow_eval.results_load_error: Results could not be loaded. Retrying.
shadow_eval.collecting_verdicts: Collecting verdicts. Results appear as sampled requests are judged.
shadow_eval.no_verdicts_recorded: No verdicts were recorded for this job.

form.direction_forward: Adoption check: key's traffic vs the router
form.direction_reverse: Regression check: router's picks vs a baseline
form.desc_forward: Duplicates a sampled slice of the selected targets' traffic (keys, teams, or users) through the auto-router and has an LLM judge compare both answers blind. Each target gets its own spend budget. The router's answers are never served to users; judge calls bill to the sampled traffic's own identity.
form.desc_reverse: Duplicates a sampled slice of the traffic the auto-router already serves against a fixed baseline model and has an LLM judge compare both answers blind. Each target gets its own spend budget. The baseline's answers are never served to users; judge calls bill to the sampled traffic's own identity.
form.error_keys: Keys could not be loaded. Refresh the page to retry.
form.error_users: Users could not be loaded. Refresh the page to retry.
form.regression_single_router_note: A regression check compares one router to its baseline
form.forward_multiple_routers_note: Every router sees the same sampled requests, judged against the same live responses
form.narrows_models_desc: Narrows every target above to requests for these models
form.spend_budget_desc: max shadow + judge spend, per target
